headline: Southern New Hampshire extends unbeaten run with scoreless draw
dek: Davis & Elkins kept Southern New Hampshire from scoring, yet the conference leader still has only one defeat beside fourteen wins and five draws. Across all matches, Southern New Hampshire has conceded twelve goals.
displaced_by: Southern New Hampshire's scoreless draw with Davis & Elkins on 2026-11-20 moved its record to fourteen wins, five draws, and one loss; previous headline also used a plural verb

pattern.text: Southern New Hampshire's sixty-one goals come from at least sixteen different scorers, so the tallest bar is the work of a squad rather than a single forward.

wire.line: Southern New Hampshire have outscored the conference's three lowest-scoring sides together.
